scope: Actual production native-meter backend and layout modules under explicit widget/native-settings mocks. Does not emulate native secret VM, rendering, secure restrictions, real combat/session engine, CPU, allocation bytes, FPS or server reset behavior. Wall timings include process/setup and are not native performance results.
intentionalBugFix: Layout embed/reflow was persisting Overall/nil over native Current/historical session selection; native dropdown owns session choice. Remove only forced selection; preserve native Overall defaults, display type ownership, settings and stored combat data. No automatic reset/deletion triggers or CVar rewrites.

autoResetSettingContract.scope: New instance, separate from Current per-fight display. Actual engine clear remains native acceptance.

configuration: Lua5.4.6; fresh deterministic process/fixture setup per run (no additional warmup). Five matched alternating pairs. Each ownership replay covers ordinary/gamepad Current,historical andOverall through500relayouts,hide/reveal,typechange,combatdefer,cleanup/reembed; layout replay retains3nativepanes+ownedthreat through500reflows. No game profile, CVars, addons, diagnostic roots or saved-variable files modified by desktop checks.
